I now have a complete picture. Here is the full report.

---

## Data Layer Location

The data/persistence layer of this repository is the **`store`** package at:

**`/bench/repo/store/`**

This is a Go package that defines all persistent entity types as Go structs, exposes CRUD methods on a central `Store` type, and abstracts database access behind a `Driver` interface (with implementations for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL under `/bench/repo/store/db/`). The database schema is maintained via migration files in `/bench/repo/store/migration/`.

Additionally, protobuf definitions for some store-level payload/setting types live at `/bench/repo/proto/store/` (with generated Go code at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/`), but the primary entity structs that map to database tables are the Go types in `/bench/repo/store/`.

---

## All Persistent Entity Types

There are **11 distinct database tables** corresponding to the following entity types (each has a primary struct plus associated Find/Update/Delete query structs):

| # | Entity Struct | File | DB Table | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **`User`** | `/bench/repo/store/user.go` | `user` | Application user (admin or regular) |
| 2 | **`UserSetting`** | `/bench/repo/store/user_setting.go` | `user_setting` | Per-user key-value settings (shortcuts, general prefs, tokens, webhooks, tags) |
| 3 | **`Memo`** | `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` | `memo` | The core content entity -- a note/memo |
| 4 | **`MemoRelation`** | `/bench/repo/store/memo_relation.go` | `memo_relation` | Relationships between memos (reference or comment links) |
| 5 | **`MemoShare`** | `/bench/repo/store/memo_share.go` | `memo_share` | Bearer-token share grants for read-only memo access |
| 6 | **`Attachment`** | `/bench/repo/store/attachment.go` | `attachment` | File attachments linked to memos (local or S3 storage) |
| 7 | **`IdentityProvider`** | `/bench/repo/store/idp.go` | `idp` | OAuth2 identity provider configurations |
| 8 | **`Inbox`** | `/bench/repo/store/inbox.go` | `inbox` | User notification inbox items |
| 9 | **`Reaction`** | `/bench/repo/store/reaction.go` | `reaction` | Emoji reactions on content (memos) |
| 10 | **`InstanceSetting`** | `/bench/repo/store/instance_setting.go` | `system_setting` | Instance-wide settings (basic, general, storage, memo-related, tags, notification, AI) |
| 11 | **`UserIdentity`** | `/bench/repo/store/user_identity.go` | `user_identity` | Linkage between external identity provider subjects and local users |

---

## Supporting/Auxiliary Types

In addition to the primary entity structs, each entity has associated query/mutation structs that are also defined in the store package:

- **`FindUser`**, **`UpdateUser`**, **`DeleteUser`** (in `user.go`)
- **`FindUserSetting`**, **`DeleteUserSetting`**, **`RefreshTokenQueryResult`**, **`PATQueryResult`** (in `user_setting.go`)
- **`FindMemo`**, **`FindMemoPayload`**, **`UpdateMemo`**, **`DeleteMemo`** (in `memo.go`)
- **`FindMemoRelation`**, **`DeleteMemoRelation`** (in `memo_relation.go`)
- **`FindMemoShare`**, **`DeleteMemoShare`** (in `memo_share.go`)
- **`FindAttachment`**, **`UpdateAttachment`**, **`DeleteAttachment`** (in `attachment.go`)
- **`FindIdentityProvider`**, **`UpdateIdentityProvider`**, **`DeleteIdentityProvider`**, **`UpdateIdentityProviderV1`** (in `idp.go`)
- **`UpdateInbox`**, **`FindInbox`**, **`DeleteInbox`** (in `inbox.go`)
- **`FindReaction`**, **`DeleteReaction`** (in `reaction.go`)
- **`FindInstanceSetting`**, **`DeleteInstanceSetting`** (in `instance_setting.go`)
- **`FindUserIdentity`**, **`DeleteUserIdentity`** (in `user_identity.go`)
- **`DeleteUserResult`** (in `user_delete.go`)
- **`AuthenticationConfigState`**, **`AuthenticationConfigMutation`** (in `auth_config.go`)

## Enum/Value Types

- **`RowStatus`** (`NORMAL`, `ARCHIVED`) -- in `/bench/repo/store/common.go`
- **`Role`** (`ADMIN`, `USER`) -- in `/bench/repo/store/user.go`
- **`Visibility`** (`PUBLIC`, `PROTECTED`, `PRIVATE`) -- in `/bench/repo/store/memo.go`
- **`MemoRelationType`** (`REFERENCE`, `COMMENT`) -- in `/bench/repo/store/memo_relation.go`
- **`InboxStatus`** (`UNREAD`, `ARCHIVED`) -- in `/bench/repo/store/inbox.go`

## Driver Interface

The `Driver` interface at `/bench/repo/store/driver.go` lists all persistence operations grouped by entity model, confirming the complete set of persistent entity types enumerated above.
